title: GST-India Invoice Document

TaxSch.description: GST- Goods and Services Tax Scheme

SupTyp.description: Type of Supply: B2B-Business to Business, SEZWP - SEZ with payment, SEZWOP - SEZ without payment, EXPWP - Export with Payment, EXPWOP - Export without payment,DEXP - Deemed Export

RegRev.description: Y- whether the tax liability is payable under reverse charge

IgstOnIntra.description: Y- indicates the supply is intra state but chargeable to IGST

Typ.description: Document Type: INVOICE, CREDIT NOTE, DEBIT NOTE

Addr2.description: Address 2 of the supplier (Floor no., Name of the premises/building)

Stcd.description: State Code of the supplier. Refer the master

Gstin.description: GSTIN of buyer , URP if exporting

Pos.description: State code of Place of supply. If POS lies outside the country, the code shall be 96.

Addr1.description: Address 1 of the buyer. (Building/Flat no., Road/Street etc.)

Addr2.description: Address 2 of the buyer. (Floor no., Name of the premises/ building)

Stcd.description: State Code of the buyer. Refer the master

Nm.description: Name of the company from which the goods are dispatched

Addr1.description: Address 1 of the entity from which goods are dispatched. (Building/Flat no.Road/Street etc.)

Addr2.description: Address 2 of the entity from which goods are dispatched. (Floor no., Name of the premises/building)

Gstin.description: GSTIN of entity to whom goods are shipped

Addr1.description: Address1 of the entity to whom the supplies are shipped to. (Building/Flat no., Road/Street etc.)

Addr2.description: Address 2 of the entity to whom the supplies are shipped to. (Floor no., Name of the premises/building).

Loc.description: Place (City,Town,Village) entity to whom the supplies are shipped to.

Stcd.description: State Code to which supplies are shipped to. Refer the master

IsServc.description: Specify whether the supply is service or not. Specify Y-for Service

GstRt.description: The GST rate, represented as percentage that applies to the invoiced item. It will IGST rate only.

CesAmt.description: Cess Amount(Advalorem) on basis of rate and quantity of item

TotItemVal.description: Total Item Value = Assessable Amount + CGST Amt + SGST Amt + Cess Amt + CesNonAdvlAmt + StateCesAmt + StateCesNonAdvlAmt+Otherchrg

PrdSlNo.description: Serial number in case of each item having a unique number.

AssVal.description: Total Assessable value of all items

CgstVal.description: Total CGST value of all items

SgstVal.description: Total SGST value of all items

IgstVal.description: Total IGST value of all items

CesVal.description: Total CESS value of all items

StCesVal.description: Total State CESS value of all items

TotInvValFc.description: Final Invoice value in Additional Currency

Mode.description: Mode of Payment: Cash, Credit, Direct Transfer

PaidAmt.description: The sum of amount which have been paid in advance.

PaymtDue.description: Outstanding amount that is required to be paid.

InvNo.description: Reference of original invoice, if any.

ForCur.description: Additional Currency Code. Refer the master

TransMode.description: Mode of transport (Road-1, Rail-2, Air-3, Ship-4)

Distance.description: Distance between source and destination PIN codes
